[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Dreloq''' was [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] peacekeeping force assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. After rioting broke out on the planet during the installation of [[Wilek Nereus]] as [[Governor/Legends|governor]], Dreloq gave a press conference stating the belief that the riots were planned with precision, rather than spontaneous events.
